paper: step 8. Provisional Section 3.3. The commons reference evaluation model is a trained artifact.
adr: Training lives under tools/evaluator-training/. This file is the LoRA run: base, hyperparameters, framework pins, seed. The generation recipe is recipe.json. The held-out suite is not an input. The training base is SmolLM3-3B after a measured 0.6B capacity ceiling. The live pin is unchanged.

base.note: Read at run time from the manifest. repoId here is a pin that must match. This is the training base. The live evaluator pin stays baseRepoId/fileName (Qwen3-0.6B Q8_0 at v2.1) until a trained SmolLM3 passes the gate.

framework.whyNotUnsloth: 3B plus 3936 short examples on an 80GB card does not need Unsloth's memory path. The standard stack is the one a reader can follow without a third training runtime. SmolLM3 modeling code requires transformers >= 4.53.0; the pin below is that version or newer.
framework.reportToNote: No cloud metric sink. Loss logs to stdout and artifacts/train-log.json. Trackio would be a Hub side channel this run does not need.
framework.torch: supplied by the GPU image; not pinned here so a CUDA wheel is not overwritten

train.enableThinkingNote: SmolLM3 thinking must stay off. No-think is enable_thinking=False, which writes Reasoning Mode: /no_think in the system metadata. train.py wraps apply_chat_template so TRL cannot drop the kwarg. Do not use Qwen's empty-think-block wrapper. Do not set assistant_only_loss to false.
train.chatTemplateNote: Stock SmolLM3-3B ChatML-with-metadata template, with {% generation %} around the verdict and im_end only. The empty think block is prefix (stock no-think) and sits outside the mask. Rendered text must match stock; train.py refuses to start if it does not, or if the assistant mask is empty, or if no-think is not active.
train.evalDatasetNote: The held-out suite is the final gate, never a training or hyperparameter split. Epochs are fixed. Loss is logged. There is no early stopping.

llamaCpp.note: convert_hf_to_gguf.py then llama-quantize Q8_0. The run records the resolved commit in artifacts.json. Q8_0 matches the live vendor pin's quantization.

time.estimate: Well under three hours on a single 80GB card. 3B LoRA, 3936 examples, 3 epochs, sequences around 2k tokens, then merge, llama.cpp convert, and 187 compact-verdict gate items. If a run is still training after 90 minutes, stop and report: that is a hang, not the expected duration.

publish.when: only after gate-report.json pass is true
publish.note: Publication writes a trainedCandidate on the model manifest. It does not replace the live v2.1 vendor GGUF and it does not change the default evaluator.
